item.description: Google has begun rolling out Android 17 QPR2 to supported Pixel devices, adding expanded interface customisation, notification and brightness controls, Auracast audio broadcasting, privacy features and foldable multitasking improvements.&nbsp;

item.title: Xiaomi 18 Pro Series launch on November 17: Watch S5, Smart Band 11, Clip TWS and 4 smart home devices confirmed
item.description: Xiaomi will launch the Watch S5 41mm, Smart Band 11, Clip TWS earbuds and four smart home appliances globally on November 17, alongside the Xiaomi 18 Pro series. The lineup will also include a new robot vacuum cleaner, expanding the company's wearable, audio and smart home portfolio.

item.title: Vivo X500 series India launch on November 26; 200MP camera tipped: Expected price and key specifications
item.description: Vivo is set to launch the X500, X500 Pro and X500 Pro Max in India on November 26, alongside the new Watch GT2. The flagship smartphones are expected to feature up to 200MP cameras, MediaTek Dimensity 9600 series processors and batteries of up to 8,000mAh. Prices reportedly start at ₹1,19,999.

item.title: Entered a fake birthday on Instagram? Meta's AI can now identify users posing as adults
item.description: Meta is expanding its AI-powered age-detection technology globally to identify teenagers who use fake birth dates to appear as adults on Instagram. The move will place more users aged 13 to 17 under Teen Account safety settings, while Meta is also introducing Apple's age-range signal in Australia.
